name: Brian Ortega
event: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling
summary: Two-time featherweight title challenger (16-5, 1 NC, age 36) making his UFC lightweight debut. He has lost four of his last five and has not fought since a lopsided decision loss to Aljamain Sterling in August 2025, about 15 months before this fight. He pulled out of two bouts with Renato Moicano this year (injuries in January, a cut over the eye in September).

how_they_fight.Striking: Low output and hittable: about 3.9 significant strikes landed a minute at 37% accuracy, and about 5.0 absorbed. Against Sterling he landed single digits in R1 and took heavy leg kicks before finally landing in R5 (Cageside Press). Has knocked out good fighters late (Frankie Edgar R1, Clay Guida and Thiago Tavares R3).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Elite jiu-jitsu, especially the guillotine. Eight submission wins, including Renato Moicano (2017, R3 guillotine) and Cub Swanson. Takedown offense is poor (29%).
how_they_fight.Defense: Takedown defense is weak (51%). Stopped twice: Max Holloway (TKO at the end of R4, 2018) and Yair Rodriguez (R1, 2022). Three decision losses (Volkanovski, Diego Lopes, Sterling). Has taken a lot of damage in long fights.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: A late finisher: of 11 stoppage wins, six came in R3 (four subs, two KOs), one in R2 and four in R1. He often loses early rounds and finds something late (R5 against Sterling, per Cageside). His wins have all come against tiring opponents, and he hasn't won since February 2024.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Patient to a fault; low early output costs him rounds. Weight and health are real concerns: he missed featherweight for Sterling (153-pound catchweight; Cageside noted rumours he had been hospitalised) and now moves up to 155.

patterns: Slow starter, dangerous late: six of 11 stoppage wins in R3
Low striking output; loses rounds on volume
concerns: Ring rust: about 15 months out by fight night
First fight at 155 after a weight-cut problem at 145
keys_to_beat: Out-work him early with volume and leg kicks
Don't shoot carelessly into his guillotine
Keep pace high to bank rounds before his late push

news.text: Will make his UFC lightweight debut against Hooker (Sherdog).
Withdrew from the UFC 331 lightweight rematch with Moicano after a cut; his second withdrawal from that fight.
Pulled out of UFC 326 with accumulated injuries; said no surgery was needed.
